headlines.title: Datadog Earnings Top Views. Shares Plunge On Weak Sales Outlook.
headlines.summary: Datadog stock tanked despite Q3 earnings that easily beat estimates. Q4 revenue guidance fell short and signaled flat sequential growth.

headlines.title: Datadog (NASDAQ:DDOG) exceeds Q3 2026 expectations but stock drops 16.1%
headlines.summary: Cloud monitoring platform Datadog (NASDAQ:DDOG) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 35.2% year on year to $1.20 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $1.20 billion, close to analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.81 per share was 26.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: Datadog Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
headlines.summary: Third quarter revenue grew 35% year-over-year to $1.20 billion Robust growth of larger customers, with about 4,860 $100k+ ARR customers, up from about 4,060 a year ago Launched Scout 1.0, Datadog's first specialized model, now powering Bits Investigation NEW YORK, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Datadog, Inc. (NASDAQ:DDOG), the leading AI-powered observability and security platform, today announced financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headlines.title: Datadog Fell Nearly 12% in a Week. Wedbush Still Expects a Beat-and-Raise on November 4
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog fell nearly 12% last week on AI spending fears, but analysts’ estimates didn’t move, and Wedbush expects another beat-and-raise quarter on Nov. 4.

description: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
